title: Dir-fsync durability sequence has no discriminating test
impact: A future refactor can silently drop the fsync and every durability claim becomes false while tests stay green (proven: fsync removed - 265/0 green)
recommended_fix: Failpoint seam behind fsync_dir + Linux unit test; or strace CI job asserting fsync(dirfd) after rename

title: Boot sweep deletes .gc-pending without the runtime resurrection re-check
impact: Crash in the recheck-fail-to-restore window leaves a live row whose last local copy is the pending file; boot destroys it (reconcile detects as phantom; unrepaired on primary)
recommended_fix: chunk_is_referenced check before pending delete; live = rename back (restore)

title: V7 test itemization said 240 vs true 265 (totals correct; breakdown miscounted)
impact: Baseline doc cannot be used as a counting authority until corrected
recommended_fix: Adopt the V8 per-binary table into v7-baseline.md and fix README:181 unit count (166)

title: Broken-config fixture lacks a post-sed hard assertion; stray duplicate sed with || true
impact: Placeholder drift makes the fixture silently valid - the inversion job can pass or fail for the wrong reason
recommended_fix: Add grep -q 'change-me-in-production' /tmp/broken.yaml || exit 1 after the seds; drop line 35
